page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a printed header ornament above the title. Title block at the top (centred), then a verse passage in italic with a woodcut initial. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: PANEGYRICUS CHRISTO, DEO, ADMIRABILI, CONSILIARIO dictus, A P. N. D.

p.i: IPSE Patris verbum, sapientia certa parentis, In laudes mihi, Christe, tuas pia suffice verba, Etraptos ad te cœlum super attrahe sensus: Vt vox plena Deo, & sacri sibi conscia motus Nec mortale sonet, nec cæco errore profanum. Nămque tua sine te præconia laudis obire Quis queat? & nova tot rerum miracula verbis Implere, & donato illustres ex hoste triumphos Dicere? Quis fractumque iugum, cæcosque rebelles? Nam coniuratos in nos tua pignora, Reges Proteris, & dextra armipotente salóque, solóque Insequeris, terræ excidium cælóque minantes. Hesperium nuper miranda clade tyrannum Vidimus amissis armis, & classe virisque Oceano in magno, ingentem occultare ruinam: Dum quos Oceanus, quos Anglicus hauserat ensis

page.notes: The page is a title page of a work with the division heading; no running head printed. The woodcut initial I is joined to "PSE" as "IPSE". Lines of the verse are kept in one paragraph with line breaks. "Insequeris" is read as printed with a long s; the first letter is doubtful and could be I or J. The last line "Lugeri" is a catchword at the lower right, not running text. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.
